aksarav-codeflowmap-claude.description: Analyzes any codebase and generates a full C4 architecture diagram suite (L1 to L4) in Mermaid syntax. Use this skill whenever the user asks to: understand a codebase, generate architecture diagrams, map a repo, document a brownfield system, find duplicates or dead code, analyze module structure, produce C4 diagrams, or onboard onto an unfamiliar project. Triggers on phrases like "map this codebase", "generate diagrams", "understand this repo", "what does this code do", "document the architecture", "find duplicates", "analyze this project". Supports Python, TypeScript, GoLang, and Java.…

aksarav-codeflowmap-codex.description: **What this is:** a repeatable methodology for reading an unfamiliar codebase like a senior staff engineer and producing a complete C4 architecture diagram suite (System Context → Container → Component → Class) in Mermaid, plus a brownfield health report and a single consolidated onboarding document.
